subject: monster called a Seawish, a sea creature of beaches: a big fish as tall as a man standing upright on its forked tail fin, its body a thick rounded tapering fish body with wet scales in deep sea green, darker on the back and paler green-grey on the belly. On top of its head grows a large thick mop of long olive and bright green kelp and seaweed fronds, wet and drooping, wider than its body, so that in water it would pass for a floating clump of seaweed. Two large round glossy black fish eyes on the front of its head, and a round gaping mouth lined with jagged white teeth and a red gullet.
